verdictStatement: ACCEPT. Reviewing to refute, I could not break v16. MCICV15-S1 is genuinely repaired: G16-14 now scopes its result requirement to cell-adding deferredSlots and names DEF-ROLE-NON-TS as exempt, and the frozen counterexample no longer produces a contradictory result map because coverageLaw, deferredSlots/1/standing and fdbRoleResultRule all agree; the reverse attack, that exempting the sentinel would strand concrete non-TypeScript role cells, fails on fdbRoleResultRule's in-place FDB disposition. MCICV15-S2 is genuinely repaired: reMeasurementAtV14.note reads 'remeasurement', the CLAUDE-V12-A1 V8/V9 and honestyRepairsFromV9 booking is restored, and a full two-spelling census shows every remaining misspelling is either booked historical text or metalinguistic quotation. The closed delta admits no silent path; the twenty-pin chain, the four source pins, both file 08 row carries at lines 303 and 350, and the thirty carried file 02 lines all reproduce exactly; the REFUSE-only enumeration is an exact seven-to-seven bijection between selector step 3 and G16-3; exactly one remeasurement block is LIVE; and the document claims nothing QUALIFIED or SATISFIED. Two advisories are recorded and neither blocks acceptance: a superseded-but-unbooked DEF-ROLE-NON-TS disposition claim in the v13 honesty ledger, whose correction chain is adjacent and explicit, and an undeclared C-CONFLICT-OWNER token in non-normative reviewGuidance. This verdict accepts the candidate as a candidate only. It does not seal, does not apply, does not mark DR-121 SATISFIED, and does not mark G16 QUALIFIED.
